text:
alina: Quick creative sprint request for next week's webinar landing + social. Need a compact asset bundle (not full campaign).

marc: what are the exact deliverables?

alina: essentials: hero tile (1200x628) light + dark, three benchmark micro-cards (1080x1080) calling out latency / cost / reliability, a deck title slide (16:9), LinkedIn ad crop (1200x627), mobile tall crop (1080x1350), and an svg icon set (clock, coin, shield). Need Figma with components and export-ready frames.

sofia: timeline?

alina: draft by Thurs noon PT, final by Mon EOD. Growth needs time to queue.

design-bot: New Figma file created: https://figma.redwood/app/file/2/WebinarSprint_Apr2026 (components + starter frames included).

marc: style direction: keep current brand palette; add a warm accent for CTA only. Use Inter for headlines, system font for body fallback. No complex illustrations; clean geometric icons.

alina: copy for micro-cards (short):
- Latency: "86ms median latency — predictable performance"
- Cost: "$0.38 / 1k tokens — lower unit cost"
- Reliability: "99.95% uptime — production-ready"

sofia: include small sparklines behind numbers. Icons mono-color (single fill). For hero consider a subtle animated GIF variant (5s, loop) that cycles the three metrics. Keep GIF size <1.5MB; provide MP4 fallback for paid channels.

alina: legal needs the micro-caption: "Internal Redwood benchmarks, Apr 2026. Results may vary." Also alt-text drafts for each image.

legal: Confirmed. Add logo clearspace min 16px. Caption font min 10pt. No customer names/logos allowed.

marc: export spec checklist: PNGs at requested sizes x2 (light/dark), GIF 1200x628 + MP4, SVG icons, layered PSD for hero if feasible, Figma components. File naming: webinar_apr2026_<asset>_<light|dark|gif|mp4>.

sofia: accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for body text; provide contrast notes in Figma. Also prepare alt-text lines in a copy block.

alina: can we get two CTA variants for hero: "Watch the Webinar" and "See the Benchmarks" for quick A/B?

marc: yes, include both frames. Also include editable text boxes for translations.

design-bot: Added task checklist and due dates in Figma. Draft frames uploaded to page "Sprint / Drafts". Comments enabled.

marc: estimate: design 5-7 hours, animation 1-2 hours, QA/exports 2 hours. Targeting Thurs draft OK.

alina: please post when draft uploaded. Growth will pick assets and build the queue after review.

sofia: quick note  for hero GIF: prefer a subtle mask animation (metric cards slide in) not aggressive motion.

legal: added a Figma comment about caption phrasing; prefer "Internal Redwood benchmarks, Apr 2026" and avoid superlatives.

alina: great — thanks everyone. We'll review Thurs and finalize Mon.
